data.name: Temporal Web
data.description: 1/day, you may use temporal stasis heightened to function as a 9th-level spell. The target of this ability appears to be wrapped tightly in spiderwebs. You can maintain up to 3 targets in a temporal web at a time-if you use this ability on a 4th target, you must select one of the other 3 targets to immediately release. This ability is the ability of a 9th-level spell.
